tools.name: public-filings_sec-form-d-search
tools.description: Find Form D and D/A notices of exempt offerings by issuer name or CIK in the vendored SEC Form D quarterly data sets (2025Q4 to 2026Q3) and return the offering fields as filed: exemptions, amounts, first sale date, and amendment link. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-filings/sec-form-d-search.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "public-filings" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: public-filings_sec-form-d-search · Public sink: public-filings_sec-form-d-search · Destructive: public-filings_sec-form-d-search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: public-filings_sec-form-d-search · Public sink: public-filings_sec-form-d-search · Destructive: public-filings_sec-form-d-search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
